$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.ds. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-DS-SET-ENUM-KEY
arms.note: an enum-value key is accepted on the js arm, where a native set compares it by identity while Map compares it structurally

arms.name: M-DS-BITS-WIDTH
arms.note: a domain whose top bit is 31 gets a word vector instead of the one Int that holds it

arms.name: M-DS-BITS-COMPLEMENT
arms.note: the complement of a one-Int set holds bits no value of the domain stands for

arms.name: M-DS-BITS-ARGUMENTS
arms.find: Context.fatalError('Bits<$shown>: the constructor $name takes arguments, so the domain is not fixed', pos);
arms.note: an enum whose constructor takes arguments is lowered as if its domain were fixed

arms.name: M-DS-BITS-RANK
arms.note: a sparse Int enum abstract takes its value as its bit, so values a word apart share one
